title: Competitive Lotka-Volterra systems with random catastrophes: invasion fitnesses and reversal of the competitive hierarchy
summary: We study a two-type individual-based population with logistic competition subject to random catastrophes: at the epochs of a Poisson process, each individual survives independently with a random, type-dependent probability. In the large-population limit, the process converges to a competitive Lotka-Volterra system perturbed by multiplicative jumps.
